description: Scale every ingredient in a recipe from one serving count to another (0.1x to 20x), with kitchen-friendly fraction hints; items without a quantity pass through unchanged. Use when cooking for more or fewer people. Do NOT use to change units (use convert_units) or to combine several recipes' ingredients (use merge_shopping_list).

from_servings.description: Servings the recipe is written for, positive, e.g. 4

note.description: Text shown instead of an amount when quantity is omitted, e.g. 'to taste' (default 'as needed')

quantity.description: Amount, non-negative; omit for items like 'salt to taste'

unit.description: Unit such as cup, tbsp, g, or a free count label like 'clove' or 'egg'

to_servings.description: Servings wanted, positive; to_servings / from_servings must be 0.1-20, e.g. 10

name: scale_recipe

factor.description: Scaling factor to_servings / from_servings (4 significant digits)

from_servings.description: Servings the recipe was written for

original.description: Original amount as text, or the pass-through note

scaled.description: Scaled quantity (2 decimals); null when no quantity was given

scaled_display.description: Scaled amount with unit and fraction hint, e.g. '2 1/2 cups (2.5)'

scaled_flag.description: true when the ingredient was scaled, false when passed through

title: Scale recipe
